the quality of COSMIC GPS radio-occultation soundings over the Arctic is generally good and that there is a systematic negative bias in summer.

(1) GPS RO soundings over the Arctic are of high quality and have uniform spatial coverage, (2) GPS RO quality is degraded in summer due to the increased moisture in the atmosphere, and (3) the impact of moisture on GPS RO quality is not limited to the tropics, but is also present in the Arctic.
